title: Top of the Divine Soul Ranking
summary: Mu Chen destroys the formation hidden in the puppet guard with Jiuyou's flames and the Great Buddha Art, and Elder Zhu Tian counts it as a pass, letting him keep the Constellation Sutra of Four Gods. Li Xuantong, who is at the Heavenly Transformation Stage, then warns Mu Chen that he is not qualified to be with Luo Li and gives him two months before they fight; Luo Li tells Li Xuantong to stay out of her choices. To get stronger quickly, Jiuyou offers to merge her Jiuyou Flames into his spiritual power, and he needs spirit value to buy the essence and blood of the Dragon Fish of Beiming. Mu Chen climbs the Divine Soul Ranking in one run, taking third from Mo Lun and then first from Su Ling'er. Su Ling'er complains to her sister Su Xuan, third on the Heavenly Ranking, and vows to teach him a lesson.
